translations.web: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says Yahweh of Armies.
translations.bsb: But now I will not treat the remnant of this people as I did in the past,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
translations.kjv: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the LORD of hosts.
translations.asv: But now I will not be unto the remnant of this people as in the former days, saith Jehovah of hosts.
